Title: Confidential computing nodes (DCSv2) support on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) in public preview

Body.Content:
Intel SGX powered confidential computing virtual machines provide isolated and trusted execution environment that protects your container applications on Kubernetes.  With this hardware based isolation execution capabilities feature on AKS you can orchestrate applications securely while keeping the data-in-use protected. Confidential computing nodes on AKS supports both enclave aware containers that are programmed for the execution environment and confidential containers that allows running an unmodified existing containers with code protection. All GA regions of DCSv2 are supported during preview.

Read more and get started.
